settings.heading: The science behind Elysium
settings.text: Targeted actives, modern delivery systems and routines designed around specific skin and hair concerns.

settings.heading: Our approach
settings.text: We start with a concern, choose actives with a clear role, and develop a texture and format that makes the product easy to use every day.

settings.heading: Formulation technologies
settings.text: Some of the technologies used across Elysium products:

settings.title: Exosome technology
settings.text: Extracellular vesicles used in advanced cosmetic formulas focused on skin renewal and a revitalised look.

settings.title: PDRN
settings.text: Polydeoxyribonucleotide — DNA fragments studied for their role in supporting the skin's natural recovery processes.

settings.title: Encapsulation
settings.text: Encapsulated actives are released gradually, helping strong ingredients feel more comfortable on the skin.

settings.title: Alpha hydroxy acids
settings.text: Mandelic and glycolic acid exfoliate the skin's surface for a smoother, brighter-looking complexion.

settings.name: PDRN
settings.text: Polydeoxyribonucleotide — DNA fragments studied in skin science for their role in supporting the skin's natural recovery processes.

settings.name: Exosomes
settings.text: Tiny extracellular vesicles used in advanced cosmetic formulas focused on skin renewal and a revitalised look.

settings.name: NAD+
settings.text: A coenzyme involved in cellular energy, explored in skincare for its role in keeping skin looking healthy and resilient.

settings.name: Mandelic acid
settings.text: A larger-molecule alpha hydroxy acid from bitter almonds, known as a gentler exfoliant for smoother-looking skin.

settings.name: Glycolic acid
settings.text: The smallest alpha hydroxy acid, used to exfoliate the surface for a brighter, more even-looking complexion.

settings.name: Vitamin C
settings.text: An antioxidant widely used to help brighten the look of skin and support protection against environmental stressors.
